custom_escalations_amount_or_percent.name: custom_escalations_amount_or_percent
custom_escalations_amount_or_percent.value: ("custom_escalations"."new_amount" is null) <> ("custom_escalations"."percent_bp" is null) and ("custom_escalations"."new_amount" is null or "custom_escalations"."new_amount" >= 0)

lease_charges_slots_only_per_slot.name: lease_charges_slots_only_per_slot
lease_charges_slots_only_per_slot.value: ("lease_charges"."basis" = 'per_slot') = ("lease_charges"."quantity" is not null) and ("lease_charges"."quantity" is null or "lease_charges"."quantity" > 0)

invoices_numbered_when_sent.name: invoices_numbered_when_sent
invoices_numbered_when_sent.value:
("invoices"."status" = 'draft') = ("invoices"."number" is null)
        and ("invoices"."number" is null) = ("invoices"."series_id" is null)
        and ("invoices"."status" = 'draft' or ("invoices"."supplier" is not null and "invoices"."recipient" is not null and "invoices"."sent_at" is not null))

payments_amounts.name: payments_amounts
payments_amounts.value:
("payments"."kind" = 'payment' and "payments"."amount_received" > 0 and "payments"."tds_deducted" >= 0 and "payments"."reverses_payment_id" is null)
        or ("payments"."kind" = 'reversal' and "payments"."amount_received" < 0 and "payments"."tds_deducted" <= 0 and "payments"."reverses_payment_id" is not null and "payments"."status" = 'active')
